title: claude-template project.config.yml
description: Config read by init.mjs. Editors with a YAML language server can validate and autocomplete it via a '# yaml-language-server: $schema=...' comment on the first line. init.mjs also uses the property list to warn about unknown (mistyped) keys.

stack.description: Free tokens matched against core/skill-map.json (laravel, react, python, ...).

package_manager.description: composer, npm, pnpm, yarn, pip, uv, ...

run_in_docker.description: Run project commands inside a container.

test_command.description: Leave empty if the project has no tests.

integration.description: Empty string if you merge straight to production.

scope.description: The only server path that may be touched.

commit_attribution.description: false: never add Co-Authored-By / Generated-with lines (also enforced by the guard-bash hook).

local_only.description: Git-ignored paths that must never be committed or read.

model.description: Default model written to settings.json (overrides model_profile).

model_profile.description: Which model each agent runs on.

deny_heavy.description: Deny Read on vendor/, node_modules/, dist/, logs, minified and map files.

allow_safe_commands.description: git status/diff/log and the test command run without a prompt.

protect_secrets.description: Deny Read on .env and local_only paths; installs the guard-secrets hook.

skills_mode.description: focused installs only skills routed for this type/stack.

token_budget.description: 0 = off. init warns when the always-loaded context is over this many tokens.

forbid.description: Words that must not appear in generated files.

hooks.description: Install .claude/hooks and register them in settings.json.

format_command.description: Run after every Write/Edit with the file path appended.

big_file_kb.description: guard-read: block whole-file reads above this size; 0 disables.

context_nudge_kb.description: context-nudge: warn when the transcript passes this size; 0 disables.
